nodes.label: Landing Page (Dark Theme)
nodes.rationale: Primary screenshot used as marketing entry point for the Bluper video editor web app; relies on a near-black canvas with low-contrast foreground to convey a cinematic, editor-native aesthetic aligned with the privacy-focused video tool brand.

nodes.label: Dark Theme Design
nodes.rationale: Nearly the entire canvas is black/very-dark grey, with faint light-grey UI outlines; choice signals that the product itself is a video editor and matches the default editing environment users see inside the app.

nodes.label: Hero Section
nodes.rationale: Center-left area contains a large headline block and CTA button region (low-contrast text against black); follows conventional above-the-fold layout for SaaS landing pages.

nodes.label: Product Mockup / Editor Preview
nodes.rationale: Right side of the page carries a visible but heavily darkened rendered preview that appears to depict the video editor UI itself (timeline, panels) — used as social proof and to show the product in place of an abstract illustration.

nodes.label: Top Navigation Bar
nodes.rationale: Faint wordmark/logo on the far left and a horizontal row of nav items along the top edge — typical product-website nav pattern with brand-left, links-right.

nodes.label: Feature / Content Sections
nodes.rationale: Below the hero, faint block shapes indicate stacked feature/content sections leading toward a footer band — the conventional vertical-scroll SaaS narrative (hero → features → footer).
